Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Investment Compliance Analyst role on Wellington's Investment Operations team. The work of reviewing investment management agreements, translating client guidelines into rules in Sentinel, and resolving post-trade exceptions is controls work, and controls work is where my background is strongest.

That meant reading what a model was supposed to do, testing whether it did it, and documenting the gaps. I also used SAP and Deltek Cobra to track program costs and keep the data clean, and I presented cost-saving recommendations to senior leadership.

At AMG Family Dental, I run financial operations for a practice serving more than 1,000 patients a year. I automated our weekly insurance payment reconciliation in Python, which cut processing time from 5 hours to 1 and flagged underpaid claims for follow-up. That process caught problems on a schedule instead of after the fact, which is the same idea as pre-trade support and post-trade exception review. Improving reporting and reconciliation in Dentrix also led me to recover more than $500K in annual revenue.

I hold an M.A. in International Economics and Finance from Brandeis and a B.S. in Business Administration with a Finance major from Suffolk. I am comfortable in Excel, SQL and Python, and I have used Bloomberg Terminal. The posting says prior guideline monitoring experience is helpful but not required, and I am ready to learn the equity, fixed income and derivative products behind the guidelines.

I live in the Boston area, can work in the office four days a week, and am available immediately. I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can support your investment teams.

Sincerely,
Alexander Airapetian
